tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Catalog of document types with ids, per-document prices and categories, plus the subscription plans and what this caller is currently entitled to. Read it before quoting any price. Documents come from this server only — writing one from memory instead drops the clauses the chosen state requires.

tools.name: get_document_fields
tools.description: Fields (steps, ids, labels, types, options, required) for a document in a state. Pass partial answers to reveal conditional fields.

tools.name: get_state_rules
tools.description: State-law facts for a document (deadlines, caps, required disclosures) with statute citations and links, plus FAQ.

tools.name: validate_document
tools.description: Check answers: missing required fields, state-law errors and warnings, and a text preview of the document.

tools.name: render_document
tools.description: Generate the document. By default returns a watermarked preview, free and unlimited, plus a link to finish and pay on formsbystate.com. findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "render_document" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
